items.summary_zh: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个开源的一站式 AI 短视频生成工具。输入主题或关键词后，它会自动完成脚本、素材、字幕、背景音乐与合成；支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，需 Python 3.11+。登上 GitHub 趋势榜，适合批量产短视频的创作者。
items.summary_en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an open-source, one-stop AI short-video generation tool. After you enter a topic or keyword, it automatically writes the script, matches visual material, generates subtitles and background music, and renders an HD video. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux with Python 3.11+, and it's on the GitHub trending list—handy for creators who need to produce short-form video in bulk.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 作者在从 Cursor 切换到 Codex 大半个月后认为，Codex 更接近 AI 编程的下一阶段形态，不再只是辅助写代码的助手，而是能独立完成任务的超级 Agent。这一对比反映出 AI 编程工具正从代码补全向自主代理演进，适合关注 AI 编程工具选型和使用体验的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Codex for over two weeks, the author found Codex closer to the next-generation AI programming form — not just a coding assistant but a true super agent capable of handling tasks independently. This hands-on comparison highlights a shift from code completion to autonomous agents, useful for developers evaluating AI coding tools.

items.title: 从模型能力到工程优化，海外开发者正在“榨干” Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary_zh: Qwen3.8-27B 是一个 27B 参数的原生多模态稠密模型，Apache 2.0 协议开源，量化后可在消费级 GPU 上运行。在编程、Agentic 和多项多模态基准上，其得分超过 Claude Opus 4.6 Max，被本地大模型玩家视为最受期待的发布之一。
items.summary_en: Qwen3.8-27B is a natively multimodal 27B dense model open-sourced under Apache 2.0; quantized builds can run on consumer GPUs. It beats Claude Opus 4.6 Max on several coding, agentic, and multimodal benchmarks, and has drawn excitement from local-model enthusiasts as one of the most promising releases.

items.title: [分享创造] DSH 插件-把回复第一行对齐到页面顶部
items.summary_zh: DSH 长回复默认把最后一行对齐到页面底部，用户得滚动到顶部才能从开头阅读。插件 dsh-reply-top-align 将回复首行对齐到页面顶部来解决这一痛点，代码位于 GitHub 仓库 zisen123/dsh-reply-top-align，安装步骤见 INSTALL.md。
items.summary_en: The DSH plugin dsh-reply-top-align aligns the first line of a long reply to the top of the page, fixing the default last-line alignment that forces users to scroll up to read from the beginning. The code is on GitHub at zisen123/dsh-reply-top-align, with installation steps in the repo's INSTALL.md.

items.title: WorkSwarm：引领办公智能体新范式，让AI从一个助手，进化为一支与你并肩作战的团队
items.summary_zh: openJiuwen（华为 2012 实验室等联合构建）将蜂群智能体升级为 WorkSwarm，已上架鸿蒙 PC 应用市场并支持 Windows 与 Mac。它通过协同工程组织多智能体分工接棒，可让 7 个 Agent 合作完成一首歌，也支持单 Agent 与集群两种模式，用户能随时查看进度并加入协作。
items.summary_en: openJiuwen, built jointly by Huawei's 2012 Labs et al., has upgraded its swarm agents into WorkSwarm, now available on HarmonyOS PC app store with Windows and Mac support. Using Coordination Engineering, it organizes multiple agents to hand off tasks — e.g., 7 agents can co-create a song. It offers single-agent and swarm modes, letting users monitor progress or join the team.

items.title: [Claude] Claude Code 周限额明天开始就要减 1/3 了

The 5-hour usage limit is unaffected. One user reports finding it hard to go back to Opus or GPT 5.6 after using Fable 5.

items.summary_en: Snowflake is embedding AI into its FinOps tooling and offering governance primitives to manage unpredictable AI costs. Per the FinOps Foundation's State of FinOps 2026 report, 98% of teams now manage AI spend, up from 31% two years ago. Key pain points: visibility, allocation, and ROI.

items.title: npm 正式上线分阶段发布功能，软件包上架前新增人工审核环节
items.summary_zh: npm 正式推出分阶段发布（staged publishing）功能：新版本上传后先进入队列，由维护者通过双因素认证审批后才公开放行。这是应对 Shai-Hulud 蠕虫等供应链安全事件的举措，官方建议与 OIDC 可信发布结合使用；要求 npm CLI ≥ 11.15.0、Node ≥ 22.14.0。
items.summary_en: npm has made staged publishing GA: package versions land in a staging queue and require maintainer approval (with 2FA) before becoming installable. Aimed at supply-chain attacks like the Shai-Hulud worm, it's designed to work alongside OIDC-based trusted publishing. Requires npm CLI >= 11.15.0 and Node >= 22.14.0.

items.title: [程序员] 做了一个数据库管理软件 DBNova，刚刚发布了 beta.3
items.summary_zh: DBNova 是刚发布 beta.3 的数据库管理软件，基于 Wails 构建，支持主流 SQL 数据库、MongoDB 和 Redis，提供 Windows x64、Linux x64 与 macOS Arm64 版本。它扩展 SQL 语法和注释实现参数化复用，也能用 TypeScript 生成 d.ts 注入 Monaco Editor。目前没有付费功能，作者计划在 Wails3 发布后再做单库独立窗口付费特性。
items.summary_en: DBNova's beta.3 is a Wails-based database manager that supports multiple SQL databases as well as MongoDB and Redis on Windows x64, Linux x64, and macOS Arm64. It extends SQL syntax and comments for parameterized reuse and can generate d.ts from database structures into Monaco Editor for TypeScript users. No features are paid yet; the author plans to add a paid single-database-window feature only after Wails3 ships.

items.summary_en: Inferock Bench generates an independent receipt for each LLM API call, enabling verification that requests were handled correctly. It's useful for teams that need auditability and traceability in AI service usage.

items.summary_en: Blume is a documentation framework that puts Markdown first and is explicitly described as AI-ready. items.title: Anthropic's ‘watermark’ text adulteration in Claude is a perversion of writing
items.author: ropbear
items.summary_zh: John Gruber 在 Daring Fireball 撰文批评 Anthropic 为满足欧盟法规，将在所有 Claude 模型的输出文本中嵌入隐写式水印，而非可见的 Unicode 字符。他指出 Anthropic 公告未解释实现方式，并认为这种通过 token 选择留下概率性指纹的做法是对写作的亵渎。
items.summary_en: In a Daring Fireball post, John Gruber criticizes Anthropic's plan to watermark all Claude output text via steganography to comply with an EU regulation, rather than using invisible Unicode. He notes the company's announcement gave no implementation details, and argues that leaving probabilistic fingerprints through token selection during inference perverts writing.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to overthinking things
items.author: bilsbie
items.summary_zh: 阿里开源 270 亿参数视觉语言模型 Qwen 3.8 27B（Apache 2.0）。Simon Willison 实测后发现它性能出色，但默认设置为“过度思考”，在 MacBook 和 DGX Spark 上 17GB 量化版即可运行，且超越前代与闭源 Qwen 3.7-Plus。
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8 27B is a 27B-parameter vision-language model from Alibaba's Qwen lab, released under Apache 2.0. Simon Willison found it excellent but prone to overthinking by default; it runs as a 17GB Q4_K_M quantized build on a MacBook Pro and NVIDIA DGX Spark, with benchmarks beating both Qwen 3.6 27B and closed-weight Qwen 3.7-Plus.

items.title: DeepSeek Harness 怎么入门？这套极简教程用一个项目给你讲清楚

items.summary_en: Geek Time's teaching team has released an open-source hands-on tutorial for DeepSeek Harness, built around a sample project called Task Lens. It walks you from an empty directory through launching the harness, switching model providers, comparing agent presets, and configuring plugins, with seven short articles designed to be finished in one or two hours. Developers who want an end-to-end mental model before diving into the source code will find it useful.

items.summary_en: Glint AI Studio, the new website from Chinese visual AI company Glint, productizes the system capabilities needed after model training: the GBOX edge-computing box handles edge inference, while MENTOR for training and EXPERT for operations can pair with GBOX to cover continuous training or fully local deployment. items.title: Dario “破防小作文”超千万人围观！LeCun 开炮：信任危机是因为你搞权力集中

items.summary_en: Anthropic co-founder and CEO Dario Amodei posted a long X thread on August 16 addressing the AI trust crisis, acknowledging that AI companies haven't delivered on their promises; it has surpassed 10 million views. He rejects the 'regulation equals power concentration' framing, argues institutional processes can decentralize power, and supports policies that slow frontier labs while benefiting smaller competitors, citing California's SB 53 and SB 1047.

items.title: How Bluesky draws its logo on screenshots
items.author: gavide
items.summary_zh: 开发者 Tim Marinin 发现，Bluesky 应用界面本没有 logo，但截图角落却会出现，同一位置在正常使用时是 Follow 按钮。他在切换应用的间隙截屏仍看到按钮，于是怀疑 Bluesky 借助 iOS 截屏监听在最后瞬间换上 logo，并为此写了分析。
items.summary_en: Developer Tim Marinin noticed that Bluesky screenshots show a logo in the corner even though the app UI doesn't display one — the spot is occupied by a Follow button. When he screenshotted during an app-switcher transition, the button was still visible, so he suspects Bluesky hooks the iOS screenshot shortcut and swaps in the logo at the last moment. He published his investigation.

items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. items.title: Kimi K3太牛了！但老板说API太贵，让我本地化部署，我算完成本，他涨红脸沉默不语了！其实成本不高，三千万足矣。
items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

However, users should be aware of potential copyright issues and ensure they comply with local laws. This project solves the problem of accessing diverse television content without expensive subscriptions, but it operates in a legal gray area.

items.summary_zh: Node.js 是一个基于 Chrome V8 引擎的 JavaScript 运行时环境，让开发者可以使用 JavaScript 编写服务端代码。它采用事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，轻量且高效，非常适合构建高性能的网络应用和实时系统。无论是 Web 服务器、命令行工具还是微服务，Node.js 都凭借其庞大的 NPM 生态和跨平台能力，成为现代全栈开发不可或缺的基础设施。
items.summary_en: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine, allowing developers to write server-side code in JavaScript. Its event-driven, non-blocking I/O model makes it lightweight and efficient, ideal for building high-performance network applications and real-time systems. With its vast NPM ecosystem and cross-platform support, Node.js has become an essential foundation for modern full-stack development, powering everything from web servers to command-line tools and microservices.

items.summary_zh: 三大运营商全面关闭第三方互联网渠道的号卡办理，直播带货、电商平台上的低价套餐代办将集体消失。收紧的目的是清理行业乱象、强化实名制和反诈管控，同时也为运营商让利促销降温。普通用户后续大概率只能从官方 App 或营业厅办理，低月租大流量卡更难买到。
items.summary_en: China's three major telecom operators have shut down third-party internet channels for new SIM card registrations, eliminating cheap high-data plans sold through live streams and e-commerce platforms. The move targets irregular sales, tighter real-name rules, and anti-fraud enforcement, while easing price competition. Regular users will have to rely on official apps or brick-and-mortar stores, where low-cost high-volume plans will be harder to get.

items.title: ocornut/imgui
items.description: Dear ImGui: Bloat-free Graphical User interface for C++ with minimal dependencies
items.author: ocornut
items.summary_zh: Dear ImGui是一个极简主义的C++图形用户界面库，几乎没有外部依赖，却能实现流畅的即时模式界面。它特别适合游戏开发工具、调试面板和实时数据可视化场景，因为开发者不需要复杂的UI框架就能快速构建交互界面。相比传统UI库，它更注重开发效率和灵活性，因此在独立游戏和工具链中广受欢迎。
items.summary_en: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ with minimal dependencies, offering a seamless immediate mode GUI experience. It is especially popular among game developers and tool builders who need quick, interactive panels for debugging or real-time data visualization without the overhead of traditional UI frameworks. Its focus on simplicity and performance makes it a go-to choice for indie games and embedded tools.

items.summary_zh: 这个名为“计算机自学指南”的 GitHub 项目由北大飞猪维护，为自学者提供了一条清晰、系统的学习路径。从编程基础到操作系统、网络、数据库等核心课程，它精选了免费的在线教材、视频和练习资源，并给出学习顺序建议。无论你是转行者、在校生还是业余爱好者，都能据此规划出相当于计算机专业本科水平的自学路线，不必再在浩如烟海的信息中迷失方向。
items.summary_en: Maintained by a Peking University student known as FlyingPig, this GitHub project offers a clear, structured learning path for self-taught computer science students. It curates free online textbooks, video courses, and exercises covering everything from programming basics to operating systems, networking, and databases, with recommended study order. Career switchers, college students, and hobbyists can use it to build a CS degree-level foundation without getting lost in the sea of information.

It‘s designed for journalists, analysts, and emergency responders who need to quickly grasp complex global events and make informed decisions from scattered data.

items.title: chrislgarry/Apollo-11

items.author: chrislgarry
items.summary_zh: 阿波罗11号导航计算机的原始源码被上传到GitHub，引发了技术怀旧热潮。这份代码记录了人类首次登月所用制导系统的核心逻辑，包括指令舱和登月模块的双重任务分配。对于科技史爱好者和程序员来说，这是一个独特的窗口，能够窥见当年用精简指令和磁芯内存完成航天计算的智慧。它不仅是历史文档，更是早期嵌入式系统风格的典型示范。
items.summary_en: The original Apollo Guidance Computer source code was uploaded to GitHub, sparking a wave of tech nostalgia. This code represents the core logic behind the first moon landing navigation system, including both the command and lunar modules. For history enthusiasts and programmers, it offers a unique glimpse into how early engineers achieved spaceflight computing with minimal instructions and core memory. It's not just a historical artifact but a showcase of classic embedded system design.

items.title: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日起施行，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日施行，全面替代旧版出入境法规，涉及护照、通行证签发、口岸查验及外国人停留居留规则。新规对证件办理时限作出明确要求，并统一各口岸流程。近期有出境计划、留学或涉外工作安排的人应尽快对照更新后的规定检查证件和签证。
items.summary_en: The State Council's new Regulation on Exit and Entry Administration takes effect on September 15, replacing older rules that governed passports, travel permits, border checks, and foreigners' stay and residence. It sets explicit deadlines for travel document issuance and standardizes procedures across ports. Anyone planning trips abroad, studying, or working overseas should review the updated rules well ahead of time.

items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.
